# Token reference

<!-- generated by tools/generators/build_on_brand.py — do not edit by hand -->

Read off the stylesheets, not written down. If a value here disagrees with
the site, the site is right and this file is stale: re-run the builder.

    python3 tools/generators/build_on_brand.py

**Use the token, never the value.** A hex code typed into a rule is invisible
to `tokens.py`, survives a palette change, and is the thing to refuse.

## The two grounds

The archive and the journal are set on paper; the desk is set on ink. That
is why the desk's palette is a different set of names, not a dark variant of
the same ones — there is no `--paper` on the desk and no `--void` on the
archive. Do not carry a token across.

| | Light properties | The desk |
|---|---|---|
| Ground | `--paper` `#FBFAF7` | `--void` `#0F0F0F` |
| Text | `--ink` `#0F0F0F` | `--text` `#F3F0E9` |
| Accent | `--seal` `#8B1A1A` | `--seal` `#8B1A1A` |

`--seal` is the same red on both, and on ink it does not hold on its own —
that is what `--seal-bright` `#E0655A` is for, and it exists **on dark grounds**
only. It is not a second brand colour.

### ⚠ `seal-bright` names two different colours

| Where | Value | On `#0F0F0F` | Good for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `beta-art-business/styles.css` | `#E0655A` | 5.64:1 | body text and graphics |
| `brand/README.md` (the mark's centre) | `#C43A2E` | 3.64:1 | large text and graphics only |

The CSS value is on roughly fifty declarations, most of them 12–13px mono
— prices, kickers, accession numbers — so it has to clear 4.5:1 and does.
The mark's centre is a graphic element and 3:1 is enough for it. Both may
be correct; **the name is not**, because one token name pointing at two
values is how a palette change goes half-applied. Naming them apart is a
person's call, so this reports and does not choose.
